method: WebSearch + WebFetch of each vendor's public-internet resources; no PDFs downloaded inline (binary fetch is operator/wget follow-up).

iso_material_groups.M: Stainless steel (>=10.5% Cr; Ni / Mo alloying)

W.use: 6 cutting edges (3/side, double-sided); economical medium machining

V.use: deep profiling; very sharp leading edge

sandvik_coromant.name: Sandvik Coromant
key_features: CoroTurn 107: external + internal turning for small + slender components
CoroTurn Prime: external + internal all-directional turning
CoroTurn TR: external profiling with iLock locking
CoroTurn 300: over + under coolant + iLock chip control
Metal Cutting Training Handbook (PDF) at downloads page — three volumes: Turning Tools, Rotating Tools, Solid Round Tools

iscar.name: Iscar
key_features: Chipformer suffix maps to application: -GN general, -NR heavy-roughing, -PP ductile, -F3P/F3S finishing, -VL high-temp + stainless valves
ECO inserts (3/8" IC) cover ~75% of turning apps with higher feed durability than standard same-size
Grade chart is the ONE-PAGER for cross-vendor application matching

widia.name: Widia (a Kennametal brand)
key_features: Widaselect coated grade — multi-layer TiN-TiCN-Al2O3-ZrCN via 800C MTCVD
K/N-group uncoated carbide — balance hardness + wear + edge stability + toughness for cast iron + non-ferrous
M/S grade — TiN PVD over unalloyed substrate for high-temp + stainless + Ti alloys at low-moderate speeds
Conversion-guide tool maps competitor grades to Widia equivalents — useful for shop floor swap when stock runs out

ingersoll.name: Ingersoll Cutting Tools
key_features: 8 PVD-coated grades (TiN/TiCN/TiAlN) + 6 CVD-coated grades — multi-layer for full ISO-P/M/K/N/S/H coverage
CT3000 cermet — P10/P20, M10/M20, K10/K20 — best surface finish on steel + stainless + cast iron
TB610 CBN — continuous/light-interrupted turning of hard steel + alloy steel + tool steel + case-hardened
TB670 CBN — high impact resistance for severe interrupted turning of chilled cast iron + hardened steel
TB730 CBN — gray + nodular cast iron + carbide rolls (high hardness + high fracture toughness)

dapra.name: Dapra Corporation
tool_systems_lathe: Indexable inserts (primarily milling-focused; some turning + profiling)
key_features: Dapra is primarily an indexable-milling vendor — turning + profiling is a smaller line
ISO material-group filter on insert selection — pick group, see only suitable inserts
Starting speed + feed charts per insert per material group + DOC recommendations
Aerospace + automotive + mold + die + firearms focus
dapra.caveat: MaxiMet appears to not be a Dapra product — operator may want to confirm the name. The Toroid PDF is Dapra's high-feed milling system; for turning, the BHID distributor page is the most direct.

pts_tools.name: PTSolutions (PTS Tools)
key_features: PTS is a distributor, not a manufacturer — cross-references major brands (Sandvik, Kennametal, Widia, etc.)
Public-site product detail is gated behind login; the on-site catalog UI is dynamic + not crawled by the public WebSearch
For PRISM lathe wizard wiring: treat PTS as a logistics/availability layer (do we have this insert in stock?), NOT a primary technical source
pts_tools.caveat: Operator may want a contracted product feed (CSV / API) from PTS rather than scraping the public site.

wizard_wiring_hints.hint: validation phase — when a JM-Die .MIN program names an insert (e.g. CNMG-432), reverse-lookup the vendor grade chart for the substrate's recommended Vc + DOC range; flag if the program's actual parameters lie outside the recommended range as ValidationIssue.physics_basis="<vendor>/<grade-chart-url>"

tool selection phase — given material (ISO-P/M/K/N/S/H) + operation (od_rough / od_finish / face / groove / thread), rank candidate inserts by (geometry x grade x vendor availability); Sandvik CoroTurn 107/Prime/TR/300 + Iscar -GN/-PP + Ingersoll TT-series are the 3 default vendor families

cost phase — Sandvik typically 1.4-1.6x Iscar list; Iscar typically 1.1-1.3x Korean (Korloy/TaeguTec); pick the lowest-cost vendor whose grade chart covers the material + cutting condition (so quote tool cost <= alternative)
render each vendor as a child node under the lathe domain roost; each node carries the resource URLs; clicking opens the vendor's grade-chart page in browser

follow_up_units.scope: operator/wget — download the 14 named PDFs from this manifest into resources/MANUFACTURER_CATALOGS/uploaded/. PRISM has no automated PDF binary fetch (WebFetch is HTML-only); this is operator work.
extend pdf-parse-extract.mjs to ingest each downloaded vendor grade chart + emit per-grade tribal records (grade x ISO-group x Vc range x DOC range)
wire vendor-tribal JSON into LatheCAMIntelligenceEngine.selectInsert — current heuristic uses material-group only; with vendor data we add grade-x-condition match
/system-viz ghost.lathe_vendors roost — surface 6 vendor nodes under the lathe domain with click-through URLs
